canonical_basis: Riot describes Baron Nashor as a Voidborn wyrm and late-game objective with a pit. The native unique grounded melee boss and slithering locomotion are project adaptations; no pit-changing spells or siege aura is inferred.
method: Original painted 2D pose masters generated from text and the own motion master for identity. No 3D, original troop pixels or third-party artwork used as generation input. Technical alpha-component isolation preserves original painted RGB and core alpha.
project_adaptation: Living grounded two-hex physical-melee unique Voidborn boss. Purple-plum armored rearing serpent with connected heavy ground coils, pale ribbed underside, multiple magenta eyes, ivory mandibles and two foreclaws. Finite NashorPit is a project encounter. No flight, burrow teleport, obstacle crossing, acid shooting, regeneration, immunity, spells or siege/global buff imported.
rights: New project-directed generated art; Riot Games owns related Runeterra and League concepts and designs. No external rights approval asserted.
